problem_statement: When the cold-chain policy service is slow to answer, the release worker crashes with an unhandled TimeoutError and the rest of the release queue is never processed. Last night one slow policy call stopped a whole wave of outbound pallets until someone restarted the worker by hand. Please make the queue run finish cleanly when the policy service times out on a request, so the remaining requests still get processed. The existing tests should keep passing and test_policy_timeout_does_not_stop_the_queue should go green.
